The whole model is on the slides above — nothing held back for the DM:

1. Pick a recurring offer, not a one-time payout. Judge it on three things: does it pay monthly, do you actually use it, and is the attribution window at least 30 days.

2. Build ONE faceless angle. Screen recording, text on b-roll, or AI voiceover listicle. Pick one and repeat it until it stops being hard.

3. Publish daily. Most posts do nothing — that's the process working, not failing. Volume is how you find the winner you couldn't have predicted.

4. Then repeat what moved and retire what didn't. One-time payouts pay for the post. Recurring pays for the back catalogue you already built.

The part most people get wrong: adding a second offer before the first one converts. That isn't diversifying, it's quitting slowly.
